text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 confirmed current defect. MultipleTesting.scala still counts null >= observed in plus-one pValues and returns Inclusive at the kth descending null in cutoff. ThresholdCutoff has only Inclusive/NoRejections; ThresholdCoreSuite still pins the inclusive numeric boundary. Direct source evaluation for nulls 1..19 and alpha .05 gives k=1, cutoff Inclusive(19), p(19)=2/20=.10. No new compiled probe was run here. Make the immediate repair independently reviewable within this mote: comparison semantics plus a supported decision method, exact agreement with the public p<=alpha rule including ties, finite extrema, attainable alpha and floating-point boundary behavior, and explicit legacy-double conversion policy. Then separately report broader statistical admission; repairing this deterministic boundary is not maxT/stepdown/HierScan certification. Current ThresholdMethod enum includes TFCE/cluster/RFT names without corresponding implementations in this module; do not advertise them as available. Preserve native null-family/identity, one/two-sided orientation and streaming requirements. Keep this mote open until its broader declared acceptance is qualified or explicitly split into separately tracked remaining scope.
